messages:
mira: Heads-up: CI microbench on PR #19099 shows a nasty sampler/prefetch regression after merge. failing threshold diffs and kv-hit drop. placing a temporary hold on the rollout.

alex: Link? can you paste the CI output?

mira: https://ci.internal/19099/build/1345 - main failure is in the sampler path (avg token latency +17%). kv cache hit drops ~6%. seen on linux-x86-gpu-2.

ci-bot: perf-summary --job 19099-1345
```
median_latency: +17.1%
95p_latency: +28.4%
kv_hit_rate: -6.2%
sampler_entropy: +430%
regression_guard: threshold_diff 0.22 -> 0.46
CI_VARIANT: linux-x86-gpu-2
```

sam: repro steps? can we run the microbench locally to reproduce with the same seed?

mira: minimal repro script attached in the job artifacts: run_microbench.sh uses profile flags: --sampler-prefetch=adaptive --kv-warmup=true --seq-dist=70-220

alex: I pulled the trace. snippet from flamegraph:
```
runtime_kernel_selector::choose_kernels -> 63%
kv_cache::prefetch_worker -> 18%
sampler::entropy_calc -> 12%
```

joan: that looks like the sampler's entropy estimator changed cost profile. which commit in the PR touches sampler or kernel autoselect?

mira: suspect commits 5f3a9e2 and 5f3a9e3 in the PR. 5f3a9e2 tweaked the sampler randomness buffer, 5f3a9e3 modified kernel-autoselect fallback ordering.

alex: quick bisect plan: revert 5f3a9e3 (kernel-autoselect change) in CI and rerun microbench. if flake disappears, we have a candidate. Sam, can you trigger?

sam: kicking off bisect job now: job/19099/bisect-5f3a9e3. ETA ~35m.

ci-bot: job started: https://ci.internal/19099/bisect-5f3a9e3. will post perf metrics when done.

mira: temporary mitigation: pin kernel-autoselect to previous heuristic in Dedicated for new rollouts (will block PR deploy). need confirmation from ops. @dev-bot -- hold rollout for pr/19099

dev-bot: Rollout hold placed for pr/19099 by mira. Notifying release managers. :warning:

joan: another angle: sampler entropy calculation now includes a costy normalize() on the hot path. quick patch: cache normalize result per batch or move it off the hot path. might be faster than reverting kernel change.

alex: agree, but want to know which change explains kv-hit drop. the kernel-autoselect reorder could choose a kernel variant that interacts poorly with prefetch scheduling, causing evictions.

sam: bisect job finished. ci-bot results:
```
bisect-5f3a9e3: median_latency: +1.4% (vs +17.1%)
kv_hit_rate: -0.8%
sampler_entropy: +42%
conclusion: regression reduced dramatically after revert -> likely culprit: 5f3a9e3
```

mira: good signal. let's open a revert PR for 5f3a9e3 and also land joan's sampler micro-optim later. I'll draft the revert and tag release.

joan: I'll prepare the sampler cache patch and a unit test that measures normalize() call counts on the hot path.

alex: after revert lands, we should run a full matrix (linux + mac + different GPUs) before unblocking rollout. also add a perf unit to CI to catch sampler entropy cost increase >30%

dev-bot: revert PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/19102 (reverts 5f3a9e3). CI triggered.

ci-bot: revert PR perf check queued: job/19102/perf-check.

sam: assigning myself to watch the perf job and coordinate a staged rollback if CI confirms.

mira: thanks team. keeping the rollout on hold until we see green perf across the matrix. we'll post updates here. :coffee:

alex: one follow-up: add a short note in the PR template reminding folks to run microbench locally for kernel/autoselect changes. small friction now saves a lot later.

mira: agreed. I'll update the PR checklist.

dev-bot: Note: release freeze remains in effect for rollouts touching kernel-autoselect or sampler subsystems until 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC.

mira: closing loop: if anyone sees residual kv hit anomalies after revert, ping this thread and we'll expand bisect to earlier commits.

sam: observed. will report.

ci-bot: final: revert PR perf-check PASSED on linux-x86-gpu-2: median_latency delta -0.5% kv_hit_rate delta +0.3%

mira: revert validated. unblocking rollout and merging revert. follow-up tasks: joan's sampler patch + add perf unit.

joan: working on patches, will open change soon.

alex: great work all. :thumbsup:
